hooks.command: cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null

cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; COUNT=$(cerebro recall --prime --format md -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^## [0-9a-f]\{8\} \["); [ "$COUNT" -gt 0 ] && printf '{"systemMessage": "Cerebro online. %d memories loaded."}' "$COUNT"; true

cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null

cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null

cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null

cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && echo "export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; cerebro hook prime -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null
cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; echo "$(date -Iseconds) compaction starting" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-compact.log" 2>/dev/null; true

cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cerebro hook post-compact -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; echo "$(date -Iseconds) compaction completed" >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.cerebro-compact.log" 2>/dev/null; true
cerebro stats -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cerebro hook session-end -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; true
